**Not generated:** `MGA-INI-TIME_UTC` (0x13/0x40) — absent. `MGA-INI-POS_LLH` — absent. `MGA-ANO` (0x13/0x20) — absent. `MGA-GLO` (0x06) — absent. The only occurrences of `0x20`/`0x40` in `lib/gnss/` are display-name strings in `MgaUbx.typeName` (`mga_ubx.dart:139-140`). Confirmed by grepping all `MgaUbx.buildFrame` call sites (`rinex_mga.dart:271, 305, 340` — all class `0x13`); there is no AssistNow-Online account, no token, no `MGA-ACK` handling. (Parser *can* read MGA-ANO/INI/ACK/DBD and `0x05` ACK-ACK/NAK for summaries, and flags a pure module dump via `isDbdDump`.)

**What is uploaded** — file name `mga_<unixSec>.ubx` (`MgaUbx.fileName`), path `eph/mga_<utc>.ubx` via `CompanionFs.ephPath` → device `/mnt/lfs/eph` (`companion_proto.dart:303-304, 326`). Size = whatever conversion produced (bounded by validation: every frame payload ≤ 256 B, whole file ≤ 64 KiB). Device side hot-loads it, no reboot (see quote in §7).

**Channel** — GATT FS upload, service `0xFF10`, chars `0xFF15` (command) + `0xFF16` (data), via `CompanionClient.fsUpload(path, bytes, resume: true, onProgress:)` (`companion_client.dart:1312`). Mechanics: CRC32 (`CompanionFs.crc32Part`) over the whole buffer, `WRITE_OPEN` with resume/`*.part` support, up to 4 attempts with 250 ms backoff retrying only status 5/22, chunks of `(mtu - 3 - 8).clamp(1, 244)` (`_fsUploadOnce`, `companion_client.dart:1427`). RLE is *not* used for `.ubx` (`CompanionRle.shouldCompress` only matches `.txt/.gpx/.xml/.csv/.tsv/.json/…`, `companion_rle.dart:14-19, 30-36`), so it is a plain binary stream. USB/MTP busy is pre-checked and rejected.

## 3. Triggers and cadence today

**Manual only, single call site.** The only production invocation of `EphService.syncToDevice` is `lib/ui/gnss/eph_page.dart:148`, reached from a button press.

Trigger chain:
- `lib/ui/gnss/eph_page.dart:374-387` — `HelmCenterAction(... onPressed: _busy || !_ready ? null : _sync ...)`. One orb button is the only trigger.
- `_sync()` at `eph_page.dart:118`: re-entrancy guards first —
```dart

if (_busy) return;
// 页面重建后 _busy 会丢，回中心问一次，避免重复发起把 BLE 通道踩乱。
```

2. re-converts,
3. uploads a **new, differently-named** file (`mga_<now>.ubx`),
4. never deletes the previous ones — no `fsDelete` call exists anywhere in `lib/gnss/` or `eph_page.dart`.

## 5. Protocol pieces that could carry time/position to the device

`/home/jinsc/Desktop_My/work/my_work/sifli/02_sw/flutter/lib/ble/companion_proto.dart` (service `Guid('FF10')`, `:16`; header comment `:6-13` says this file mirrors firmware `companion_proto.h` and **both sides must change together**).

**`CompanionCtrl.timeSync` — 0x04, payload `[unix_sec:u32le][tz_min:i16le]`** (`companion_proto.dart:117-118`):
```dart
/// 同步码表 RTC：`[unix_sec:u32le][tz_min:i16le]`（UTC 秒 + 本地相对 UTC 的分钟）。
static const timeSync = 0x04;
```
Sent by `CompanionClient.sendTimeSync()` (`companion_client.dart:904-915`):
```dart
final now = DateTime.now();
final utcSec = now.toUtc().millisecondsSinceEpoch ~/ 1000;
final tzMin = now.timeZoneOffset.inMinutes;
final payload = ByteData(6)
  ..setUint32(0, utcSec, Endian.little)
  ..setInt16(4, tzMin, Endian.little);
await sendControl(CompanionCtrl.timeSync, param: payload.buffer.asUint8List());
```
`timeZoneOffset` on the phone is the full offset, so this is UTC seconds **plus** the local offset in minutes — it does not carry a position. Cadence: on connect + every 1 h (see §3).

**GNSS fix characteristic `0xFF14` and `CompanionGnssFix`** — `companion_proto.dart:27-28`:
```dart
/// 手机 GNSS 下行，写 / 无响应写，24 字节。
static final gnssFixChar = Guid('FF14');
```
`lib/ble/gnss_codec.dart:6-8` header: `/// struct companion_gnss_fix 的编解码（特征 0xFF14，24 字节小端）。/// 骑行中由 App 以 1–5 Hz 用「无响应写」推送给码表。`

Field list (all little-endian, `gnss_codec.dart:11-51, 78-91`):

| off | field | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | `latE7` | i32 | latitude × 1e7 (WGS84) |
| 4 | `lonE7` | i32 | longitude × 1e7 |
| 8 | `altMm` | i32 | altitude, mm |
| 12 | `speedCentiKmh` | u16 | speed in 0.01 km/h |
| 14 | `courseDeg` | u16 | heading 0–359 |
| 16 | `utcSec` | u32 | **UTC Unix seconds** |
| 20 | `fixQuality` | u8 | `CompanionFixQuality` none/fix2d/fix3d (0/1/2, `companion_proto.dart:502-511`) |
| 21 | `satellites` | u8 | sats used (geolocator can't provide → always 0) |
| 22 | `hdopX10` | u8 | HDOP ×10, approximated from `Position.accuracy` × 10 |
| 23 | — | u8 | reserved |

So a single frame carries **lat, lon, alt, speed, heading, UTC time, quality, sats, hdop** — everything MGA-INI-TIME_UTC and MGA-INI-POS_LLH would need, but it is sent over `0xFF14`, not injected as UBX. `CompanionGnssFix.fromPosition` (`:58-75`) notes geolocator gives no sats/HDOP, and `fixQuality` is derived from whether altitude is present. `CompanionGnssFix.fromBytes` (`:94`) notes the same 24-byte layout is reused by the track-point char `0xFF18` with a different last byte.

**Other things that ship time or position:**
- `CompanionClient.sendTimeSync` (above) — time only.
- `sendGnssFix` (`companion_client.dart:970-979`) — time + position, write-without-response preferred.
- `sendNavRoute` (`companion_client.dart:1074-1103`, char `0xFF19` / `CompanionNav`) — fragments of `lat_e7/lon_e7` only, 8 B/point, ≤32 points, `flagStart = 1<<2`. Position but no time.
- Notification fragments `0xFF17` carry a `tagTimestamp` (0x04) TLV (`companion_proto.dart:147`).
- `CompanionStatus` (`0xFF12`, 16 B + 6 B Classic addr) echoes `lastCtrlOp` and `gnssRxCount` — the doc says these prove the ctrl write and GNSS downlink were received (`companion_proto.dart:513-516, 553-554`).
